function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT account_code, account_name,
       SUM(CASE WHEN period = '2026-08' THEN amount_cad ELSE 0 END) AS aug_amount,
       SUM(CASE WHEN period = '2026-09' THEN amount_cad ELSE 0 END) AS sep_amount,
       SUM(CASE WHEN period = '2026-09' THEN amount_cad ELSE 0 END) -
       SUM(CASE WHEN period = '2026-08' THEN amount_cad ELSE 0 END) AS change_cad
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.gl_balance
WHERE account_type = 'opex' AND period IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
GROUP BY account_code, account_name
ORDER BY change_cad DESC","purpose":"Compare OPEX accounts between Aug and Sep 2026"}
